g.text: Wall cabinets: the cabinets stand at the plate's edge, plumb with its wall, over the fittings; the runs move inboard to a loop round the press (r 1.65); no deck, no girders over the corners.
SOUTH ELEVATION (from the south; x right)
EAST ELEVATION (from the east; north right)
on N wall cabinet (drive) (E, W) + N guide column (E, W):
54% of its walls over open air
outer wall spans 1.1 over the runs, column to wall cabinet
on the plate top, borne: landing shoulder, N guide foot (E, W),
N wall cabinet (drive) (E, W), SE wall cabinet (switchgear),
SW wall cabinet (hydraulic), E/W face north wall cabinet,
Runs: on the plate top inboard (r 1.65), every bend on the
plate, none over the open corners; on junction risers and
saddles each side of the bays they bridge. The pipe runs in
the plate from each closed wall fitting to its riser's
flange (dashed). Legs: root in the plate's notch face, pad
on the ground; the corners hold only the legs.

svg.text: red oxide (press frame, drive, rig frame)
base borne by what is under it
other directions' runs and fittings; pipe inside the plate
